title: Trace-class source
statement:
Use the finite-coefficient setting of [def-trf-correspondence]: $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ for the fixed algebraic closure of the finite field, $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\geq1$ and $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $X$ and $C$ separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $c=(c_1,c_2):C\to X\times_s X$, $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and an admissible cohomological correspondence
$$
u:Lc_2^*K\longrightarrow Rc_1^!K.
$$
Here $D^b_{ctf}$ is the finite-Tor subcategory of the bounded constructible finite-torsion category [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], and all operations are those of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Put $M=Lc_2^*K$, $N=Rc_1^!K$, and define the trace-class source by
$$
\mathcal H_c(K):=R\mathcal Hom_A(M,N)\in D(C,A).
$$
The internal Hom is taken in the ambient derived category of $A_C$-modules on the small pro-etale site of $C$; $A_C$ denotes the constant coefficient sheaf placed in degree zero. Use the derived tensor–internal-Hom adjunction and its unit object $A_C$ from [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal]. Write $\lambda_M:A_C\otimes_A^L M\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ for the left unit isomorphism and $\eta^M$ for the unit of $-\otimes_A^L M\dashv R\mathcal Hom_A(M,-)$. Define the mate, as specified data, by
$$
\widetilde u:=R\mathcal Hom_A(M,u\circ\lambda_M)\circ\eta^M_{A_C}:
 A_C\longrightarrow\mathcal H_c(K).
$$
Equivalently, $\widetilde u$ is the image of $u\circ\lambda_M$ under the adjunction bijection. Thus the canonical bijection
$$
\operatorname{Hom}_{D(C,A)}(A_C,R\mathcal Hom_A(M,N))
\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_{D(C,A)}(M,N)
$$
is the inverse adjunction bijection followed by precomposition with $\lambda_M^{-1}$, and identifies $\widetilde u$ with $u$.

The base statement is the blueprint text, which is identical in main-20261015 (order 2624) and master (order 2280): H_c(K)=RHom_A(Lc_2^*K,Rc_1^!K) in D(C,A), and the mate ũ:A_C→H_c(K) comes from the tensor–internal-Hom adjunction. The delivery adds one stmt_dep, the existing lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal (Stacks 08J9 at sites-cohomology l.8896 and 0FPT at l.13136; no SGA). It supplies the unit A_C[0], the unitor and Hom(K⊗L,M)≅Hom(K,RHom(L,M)) with counit e. Its hypotheses hold: the pro-étale site sits on a V-small skeleton and A_C is commutative. Its tensor (K-flat first factor) and its def-pur-derived-internal-hom are the same as in def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom. The explicit mate ũ=RHom(M,u∘λ_M)∘η^M_{A_C} type-checks and is the adjoint of u∘λ_M; with e∘(ũ⊗1)=u∘λ_M, precomposing with λ^{-1} gives back u. So the delivery makes the blueprint's implicit choice explicit and changes nothing. The setting (k=F̄_q, A=A_{E,n}, ℓ≠p, separated finite-type X and C, c_2 ordinary leg, c_1 exceptional leg, admissible u, K in D^b_ctf) agrees with def-trf-correspondence and its blueprint_update and with def-trf-coefficient-conventions. Nothing is strengthened and no constructibility of RHom is claimed. The new edge is acyclic (closure of 255 nodes without the item), and the citers (def-trf-trace-class, lem-trf-trace-map-from-external-duality and others) use only H_c and ũ↔u.
